answer: Locks are recorded in thread, expire in island, and plume lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 92 aliases hence needs 28 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3517 identities would post 2499 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
